title: Story bed: resolve / uplift
description: Piano arpeggios and the major motif; strings, a soft kick and shaker from bar 8; violins and a harp lift in bars 16-19.
usage: The motif version: for intros, outros and gaps between lines. Under speech prefer the -underscore version. Loops seamlessly. -26 LUFS-S with a voice pocket at 1.25-2 kHz for the narration; duck it with scripts/audio/duck.py (the band-split duck, its default). All four story beds share 75 BPM, so they can be switched on a bar line (every 3.2 s).
selfReview: D major: piano arpeggios an octave up, the major motif on vibes and violins, strings, a soft kick and shaker from bar 8, and a harp lift at bar 16; the A7sus4 at the loop end leads back to D. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the piano (width 0.6; its stem was uncorrelated left to right) and harp (0.7) are narrower: stereo correlation 0.61 and mono loss 1.1 dB, with no anti-phase window (0.43, 1.7 dB and a windowed minimum of -0.39 before). The bass is the dark finger-plucked one. Under Zoo with the band-split duck its index is 0.83 (0.77 before with the broadband duck, just under speech-shaped noise); the narrowest band, 800 Hz, has 10-11 dB of margin (7.5 before). The -underscore version mutes the motif and lead lines; use it under speech. Critic round 2 (2026-11-24): Voice index 0.822-0.854 (worst show en) over the four narrations; -26.0 LUFS-S; phone prominence against Zoo +0.6 dB. Harp +0.2 c median (n 10, 0 beyond 10 c) (critic: -10.1 c); piano -0.1 c median (n 159, 0 beyond 10 c) (critic: D4 -11.7 c).
